name: matchhire
description: MatchHire full-stack workspace - run Backend (Express + MySQL + Redis) and Frontend (Vite + React) together.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "be,fe" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
